name: test_login
description: Sign this chat's Browser Control browser in to the app as the test account of one account tier (administrators only), to use the app as a person of that tier would

repeat_guard.hint: a repeat replaces this chat's test sign-in with a fresh one for the same turn

tier.description: The account tier id to test as, for example free, or anonymous for a fresh not-signed-in visitor; never administrator

examples: test the app as a free user
check what an anonymous visitor sees
sign in as a test account
